# SAVEE

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 5 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: A warm off-white design-reference library: saveeFont throughout, black pills on #fdfdfd, a #f3f3f3 shell, and a dark FAQ and contact that flip the pill to white.

Captured 2026-11-19, Public marketing and signed-out login. The email field was filled, then cleared, and not submitted. Google and Apple were not followed. No card was entered.. Themes: light, dark.

Savee (savee.it, which redirects to savee.com) is a visual reference library for designers. This package records the public marketing site, public browse pages, and the empty login wall, refreshed on 2026-11-21. Desktop marketing frames are CSS 1440 by 900. Phone frames are CSS 390 by 844. The email field was left empty. `login-extracted` stays not-started.

## Typography

6 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: saveeFont.

### Fonts (from README.md)

saveeFont is the UI face, with "saveeFont Fallback" and Savee in the stack. Body computes `saveeFont, "saveeFont Fallback", Savee, sans-serif`. The italic face is declared as saveeFontItalic and was unloaded on home. These families are named as computed. The font files are not in this package. Tokens keep the measured stack and fall back to ui-sans-serif.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

Home shell `#f3f3f3` is a Tailwind arbitrary value, not a custom property. Pill radius computed as `16777200px`. `--nav-height` is 100px and the rendered bar is 64px. The login wall PNG is 2880 by 1800 because the preview window devicePixelRatio is 2. The CSS viewport for that shot was 1440 by 900. Gray scale steps still cite the 2026-11-19 pass.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the warm off-white page and the gray shell.** Home renders on `#fdfdfd` with a `#f3f3f3` shell and `#0a0a0a` headlines. [patterns.md](patterns.md) describes that shell.
- **Use black pills for the primary action in light, and white pills in dark.** "Join for free" is `#0a0a0a` with `#fdfdfd` text on marketing, and the reverse on FAQ. [components.md](components.md) lists the sizes.
- **Keep login as an email field.** https://savee.com/login/ asks for an email or username and emails a link. Do not invent a password field or a signed-in library behind it. [components.md](components.md) records the gap.
- **Use saveeFont for every role.** Headlines, nav, buttons and fields share one family. [tokens.json](tokens.json) keeps that stack.
- **Stop at the empty login wall.** Google, Apple, Continue and the signed-in library were not entered.
